legacy_root.strongest_surviving_counterargument: PR-ONLY is a publication policy, not an install reconciler. A single-owner estate that never ships a public index can still carry a committed registry that disagrees with files on disk, a lockfile that is missing, or a leftover tree after a revert PR. Those local modes stay reachable. The surviving preference is that PR review is enough operationally; that preference does not make today's disagreement count zero, and it does not convert public marketplace modes that PR-ONLY makes unreachable into mitigated controls.
